description: This file is a CMake module script designed to locate and configure the systemd library for a build system. It checks for the presence of systemd using pkg-config, finds necessary libraries and headers, and sets up imported targets for use in the build process.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds and loads the specified package, in this case, PkgConfig and later Systemd.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a package using pkg-config.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the library file for systemd.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the header file sd-daemon.h for systemd.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake modules, such as FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package finding, setting appropriate variables.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported library target for systemd.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported target, such as location and include directories.
